**The University of Jordan**
  
| Course Number | Course Title                           | Credit Hours |
|---------------|----------------------------------------|--------------|
| 0401311       | Analytic Exegesis                     | 3            |
| **Prerequisites:**                                      |
| Course Description:                                      |
| This course trains the student on the art of exegesis and its books; it also teaches how to analyze Qur'anic texts from a linguistic and rhetorical point of view. The exegesis of Surat al-Nisa' is a requirement of the course in addition to the meaning of certain vocabularies of the first half of the Qur'an. |

| Course Number | Course Title                           | Credit Hours |
|---------------|----------------------------------------|--------------|
| 0431312       | Qur'anic Stories                       | 3            |
| **Prerequisites:**                                      |
| Course Description:                                      |
| The course discusses the concept of the (story) in Qur'an; the characteristics and goals of Qur'anic narratives; methods of research in Qur'anic stories; al-Isra'iliyāt (The accounts narrated by Israelites). The course also concentrates on how the Qur'anic Story assists in understanding the Divine bases of change in life, soul, and society. An applied discussion is required on some narratives of certain Prophets. |

| Course Number | Course Title                           | Credit Hours |
|---------------|----------------------------------------|--------------|
| 0441314       | Qur'an Recitation Skills and Teaching Methods | 3      |
| **Prerequisites:** (0431112 & 0441213)                     |
| Course Description:                                      |
| This course provides students with a set of advanced concepts and skills in recitation and intonation of the Holy Qur'an, from both a theoretical and applied skill standpoint, and advanced training skills commensurate with the needs of the labor market. The student studies how to employ the science of stopping and starting to clarify the meanings of verses when reading them and the ability to judge readings. Reciters, how to stop with rum and isham, how to start with hamzat al-wasl, advanced discussions, warnings, and individual Hafs readings, and the path of Qasr al-Mufassil from the path of Taybah. The student is also trained in the skills of holding courses, methods of teaching Tajweed, and memorization circles in mosques, schools, and Qur'anic centers for beginners and advanced students. This is applied to topics in the science of Tajweed that were studied in the courses on the provisions of reading the Qur'an 1 and 2, along with memorizing Surat Al-Baqarah and mastering its reading by heart with the rulings. And reading eight parts of the Holy Qur'an from a licensed sheikh.
